spec.title: Verification discrimination: base vs head
spec.problem: _verify_findings() runs verification commands only in the HEAD worktree. A command that exits 0 is stamped 'confirmed', but it may also exit 0 at BASE — meaning the condition pre-existed this PR. Such a finding is non-discriminating and must not block.

changes.detail: Add: base_sha="$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json baseRefOid --jq '.baseRefOid' 2>>"$run_dir/gh.log")" — if unresolvable, log warning and set base_sha empty (graceful degradation: all head-exit-0 findings get confirmed as before).

Create base_wt_dir using mktemp with prefix 'review-worktree.base.XXXXXX' (the prefix MUST start with 'review-worktree.' so the existing cleanup glob catches leaks). Use 'git worktree add "$base_wt_dir" "$base_sha" --detach --quiet'. On failure: log to $run_dir/worktree.log, set base_wt_dir empty string.
Clean up BOTH worktrees. Loop over "$wt_dir" and "${base_wt_dir:-}", skip empty, git worktree remove --force each, then rm -rf.
Change call to: _verify_findings "$wt_dir" "${base_wt_dir:-}" — second arg may be empty string.

Accept base_wt_dir as sys.argv[7] (empty string = no base). After head result.returncode == 0: if base_wt_dir is non-empty, run the SAME command in base_wt_dir. Log base exit code/stdout/stderr to the same verify log with '=== base exit code: N ===' prefix. If base also exits 0 → non-discriminating: set claimed_severity='blocking', severity='non-blocking', verification_status='inconclusive', prefix summary with '[non-discriminating] '. If base exits non-zero → truly discriminating: verification_status='confirmed'. On base timeout/exception → treat as confirmed (conservative). If base_wt_dir is empty → confirmed (graceful degradation).

spec.test_oracle: Test 20 (non-discriminating → APPROVE) must pass. Tests 15-17 must remain green. Test 15 is the positive discrimination case: test -f scripts/gate.sh exits 0 at head (gate.sh added in head commit) but exits 1 at base (no gate.sh there) → confirmed → REJECT. Test 20: test -d scripts exits 0 on BOTH base and head → non-discriminating → APPROVE.
